title: On the Asymptotic Causal Structure in Gravitational EFTs
summary: It is usually assumed that a healthy EFT should not allow superluminal propagation. In the presence of gravity, however, the notion of superluminality becomes subtle, since there is no invariant way to compare with an underlying Minkowski light cone. One can instead resort to an asymptotic criterion: whether the EFT can induce signal propagation faster than what allowed by the asymptotic structure of spacetime. In this work we study the asymptotic causal structure of gravitational EFTs by analysing signal propagation in black-hole backgrounds in the presence of higher-derivative operators.…
